_comment: Hand-labelled messages for comparing routing deciders (novaai/decide.py; run tools/eval-routing.py). expect = the tool a good router picks, or 'none' when the voice model should just answer. tag marks the hard ones: trap = a tool word used in ordinary talk, lang = not English, indirect = no keyword, ambiguous = two readings, but the label is the likelier one. Tools marked planned in decide.CATALOG are not built yet; they are here so a decider is judged on the catalog we are heading for.
